function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The question asks for the treatment effect as a difference in proportions (treatment minus control). While a raw difference is technically possible, it is invalid due to confounding by severity: treatment is systematically assigned to sicker patients, who have lower response rates regardless of treatment. Reporting the raw difference would be misleading and would not reflect the true treatment effect. The only valid estimate is the adjusted (standardised) difference, which accounts for severity. The conclusion does not claim causality but reports the best available estimate of the treatment effect under observational conditions. The method is justified by the data dictionary, which warns that non-randomisation leads to confounding. Therefore, the adjusted difference is the correct estimand."}
function.name: resolve_finding
